$comment: Single source of truth for the Select API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one value from a list that matches your style, with full keyboard support.

value / defaultValue.description: The chosen value (controlled or not). Use onValueChange to hear about changes.

label.description: Visible label. Without it, pass an aria-label.

hint / error.description: Help text, or an error that also marks the select invalid.

name.description: Adds a hidden input so the value is submitted with forms.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Click or press ↓ to open, type a letter to jump, Enter to choose. In HTML, add data-vin-select and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Placeholder, error, disabled
examples.description: Show a placeholder until something is chosen, an error that is read out with the field, or a disabled select.

a11y: Follows the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox pattern: role="combobox" on the button, role="listbox" and role="option" for the list.
Focus stays on the button; aria-activedescendant tells screen readers which option is highlighted.
Keys: ↑ ↓ Home End PageUp PageDown to move, Enter or Space to choose, Esc to close, Tab chooses and moves on, letters jump to matching options.
The list opens in the top layer and flips above the button when there's no room below.
Need it to work without JavaScript? Use Native Select.
